markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (43%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability is near zero and all four classes sit in the conformal set. [F6]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 43%, Normal 25%, Benign 22%, Invasive 10% | No clear leader |
| Conformal set | All four classes at 90% | Cannot separate classes |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.004 reliability; OOD 100th percentile | Input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Different top class | No independent support |
| Similar cases | 0 of 5 match; all Normal | Neighbors disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Score below typical; concept model leans away from invasive · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 9) · ↓ invasive · Below typical score; spot check 0/20, do not rely · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 0) · context · Typical score; descriptive only, spot check 8/20 · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below typical score; concept model leans slightly invasive · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses (0/20) is unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- The resampled, degraded image distorts every feature score here.
- All five similar cases are Normal, contradicting the InSitu suggestion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 11, 9** — Look for infiltrating tumor in stroma; model scored invasion low.
2. **Region 7** — Look for atypical cells confined within ducts.
3. **Region 10** — Highest per-region invasive probability (16%); confirm or exclude invasion.
